name: The Something Variant
author: AAidalol
description: A very buffed remake of the old NLW AALL level, 'The 7th Variant'. Aida made this level whilst her Tendonitis was flaring back up, and beat it on her left hand purely out of spite to send a message that she wont let tendonitis stop her. Has two 1 frame window clicks. Hardest part is the last ship.
